namespace PhpCsFixer\Fixer\StringNotation;

use PhpCsFixer\AbstractFixer;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\CodeSample;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\FixerDefinition;
use PhpCsFixer\FixerDefinition\FixerDefinitionInterface;
use PhpCsFixer\Preg;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\CT;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\Token;
use PhpCsFixer\Tokenizer\Tokens;

/**
 * @author Dave van der Brugge <dmvdbrugge@gmail.com>
 */
final class SimpleToComplexStringVariableFixer extends AbstractFixer
{
    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'Converts explicit variables in double-quoted strings and heredoc syntax from simple to complex format (`${` to `{$`).',
            [
                new CodeSample(
                    <<<'EOT'
                        <?php
                        $name = 'World';
                        echo "Hello ${name}!";

                        EOT
                ),
                new CodeSample(
                    <<<'EOT'
                        <?php
                        $name = 'World';
                        echo <<<TEST
                        Hello ${name}!
                        TEST;

                        EOT
                ),
            ],
            "Doesn't touch implicit variables. Works together nicely with `explicit_string_variable`."
        );
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     *
     * Must run after ExplicitStringVariableFixer.
     */
    public function getPriority(): int
    {
        return -10;
    }

    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        return $tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_DOLLAR_OPEN_CURLY_BRACES);
    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $tokenCount = \count($tokens);
        if ($tokenCount < 3) {
            return;
        }

        $namespaceDeclarations = $tokens->getNamespaceDeclarations();
        $nonCandidateKinds = [
            T_WHITESPACE,
            T_COMMENT,
            T_DOC_COMMENT,
            T_VARIABLE,
            T_STRING,
            T_CONSTANT_ENCAPSED_STRING,
            T_ENCAPSED_AND_WHITESPACE,
            T_CURLY_OPEN,
            T_NUM_STRING,
            T_LNUMBER,
            T_DNUMBER,
            T_START_HEREDOC,
            T_END_HEREDOC,
            CT::T_CURLY_CLOSE,
            CT::T_DOLLAR_CLOSE_CURLY_BRACES,
            T_OBJECT_OPERATOR,
            T_OPEN_TAG,
            T_CLOSE_TAG,
            T_INLINE_HTML,
            T_ECHO,
            T_PRINT,
            T_RETURN,
            T_FUNCTION,
            T_CLASS,
            T_INTERFACE,
            T_TRAIT,
            T_IF,
            T_ELSEIF,
            T_ELSE,
            T_SWITCH,
            T_FOR,
            T_FOREACH,
            T_WHILE,
            T_DO,
            T_NAMESPACE,
            T_USE,
            T_AS,
            T_NEW,
            T_CLONE,
            T_INSTANCEOF,
            T_ARRAY,
            T_LIST,
            T_UNSET,
            T_ISSET,
            T_EMPTY,
        ];
        if (\defined('T_NULLSAFE_OBJECT_OPERATOR')) {
            $nonCandidateKinds[] = T_NULLSAFE_OBJECT_OPERATOR;
        }

        for ($index = $tokenCount - 3; $index > 0; --$index) {
            $token = $tokens[$index];
            $tokenId = $token->getId();
            $tokenContent = $token->getContent();
            $tokenIsArray = $token->isArray();

            if (null === $tokenId && '' === $tokenContent) {
                continue;
            }

            $whitespaceCharacters = " \t\n\r\0\x0B";
            $isWhitespaceToken = false;
            if ($tokenIsArray) {
                if (T_WHITESPACE === $tokenId && '' === trim($tokenContent, $whitespaceCharacters)) {
                    $isWhitespaceToken = true;
                }
            } elseif ('' === trim($tokenContent, $whitespaceCharacters)) {
                $isWhitespaceToken = true;
            }
            if ($isWhitespaceToken) {
                continue;
            }

            if (!$tokenIsArray) {
                continue;
            }
            if (\in_array($tokenId, $nonCandidateKinds, true)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (T_DOLLAR_OPEN_CURLY_BRACES !== $tokenId) {
                continue;
            }
            if ('${' !== $tokenContent) {
                continue;
            }

            $scopeStartIndex = 0;
            $scopeEndIndex = $tokenCount - 1;
            foreach ($namespaceDeclarations as $namespaceDeclaration) {
                $declarationScopeStart = $namespaceDeclaration->getScopeStartIndex();
                $declarationScopeEnd = $namespaceDeclaration->getScopeEndIndex();
                if ($index < $declarationScopeStart) {
                    continue;
                }
                if ($index > $declarationScopeEnd) {
                    continue;
                }
                $scopeStartIndex = $declarationScopeStart;
                $scopeEndIndex = $declarationScopeEnd;
            }

            $varnameIndex = $index + 1;
            if ($varnameIndex > $scopeEndIndex) {
                continue;
            }

            $varnameToken = $tokens[$varnameIndex];
            $varnameId = $varnameToken->getId();
            $varnameContent = $varnameToken->getContent();
            if (!$varnameToken->isArray()) {
                continue;
            }
            if (T_STRING_VARNAME !== $varnameId) {
                continue;
            }
            if ('' === $varnameContent) {
                continue;
            }

            $variableContent = '$';
            $varnameLength = \strlen($varnameContent);
            for ($charIndex = 0; $charIndex < $varnameLength; ++$charIndex) {
                $variableContent .= $varnameContent[$charIndex];

            if ($dollarCloseIndex > $scopeEndIndex) {
                continue;
            }

            $dollarCloseToken = $tokens[$dollarCloseIndex];
            if (!$dollarCloseToken->isArray()) {
                continue;
            }
            if (CT::T_DOLLAR_CLOSE_CURLY_BRACES !== $dollarCloseToken->getId()) {
                continue;
            }
            if ('}' !== $dollarCloseToken->getContent()) {
                continue;
            }

            $previousIndex = $index - 1;
            $tokenOfStringBeforeToken = $tokens[$previousIndex];
            $stringContent = $tokenOfStringBeforeToken->getContent();

            $stringStartIndex = $previousIndex;
            $foundStringStart = false;
            for ($scanIndex = $previousIndex; $scanIndex >= $scopeStartIndex; --$scanIndex) {
                $scanToken = $tokens[$scanIndex];
                $scanId = $scanToken->getId();
                $scanContent = $scanToken->getContent();
                if ($scanToken->isArray()) {
                    if (T_START_HEREDOC === $scanId) {
                        $stringStartIndex = $scanIndex;
                        $foundStringStart = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    if (T_ENCAPSED_AND_WHITESPACE === $scanId) {
                        $stringStartIndex = $scanIndex;
                    }
                } elseif ('"' === $scanContent || 'b"' === strtolower($scanContent)) {
                    $stringStartIndex = $scanIndex;
                    $foundStringStart = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            $indent = '';
            $indentSearchIndex = $foundStringStart ? $stringStartIndex : $index;
            $whitespaceTokenForIndent = null;
            $whitespaceIndex = null;
            if ($tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_WHITESPACE)) {
                $searchIndex = $indentSearchIndex;
                while (true) {
                    --$searchIndex;
                    if ($searchIndex < 0) {
                        break;
                    }
                    $whitespaceCandidate = $tokens[$searchIndex];
                    $whitespaceCandidateId = $whitespaceCandidate->getId();
                    if ($whitespaceCandidate->isArray() && T_WHITESPACE === $whitespaceCandidateId) {
                        $whitespaceIndex = $searchIndex;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            while (null !== $whitespaceIndex) {
                if ($whitespaceIndex < $scopeStartIndex) {
                    break;
                }
                $whitespaceTokenForIndent = $tokens[$whitespaceIndex];
                $whitespaceContent = $whitespaceTokenForIndent->getContent();
                if (str_contains($whitespaceContent, "\n")) {
                    $explodedContent = explode("\n", $whitespaceContent);
                    $indent = end($explodedContent);
                    break;
                }
                if ($whitespaceIndex > 0) {
                    $tokenBeforeWhitespace = $tokens[$whitespaceIndex - 1];
                    $beforeWhitespaceId = $tokenBeforeWhitespace->getId();
                    $beforeIsOpenTag = $tokenBeforeWhitespace->isArray() && T_OPEN_TAG === $beforeWhitespaceId;
                    $beforeIsComment = $tokenBeforeWhitespace->isArray() && (T_COMMENT === $beforeWhitespaceId || T_DOC_COMMENT === $beforeWhitespaceId);
                    if ($beforeIsOpenTag || $beforeIsComment) {
                        if ("\n" === substr($tokenBeforeWhitespace->getContent(), -1)) {
                            $explodedContent = explode("\n", $whitespaceContent);
                            $indent = end($explodedContent);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                $indentSearchIndex = $whitespaceIndex;
                $whitespaceIndex = null;
                $searchIndex = $indentSearchIndex;
                while (true) {
                    --$searchIndex;
                    if ($searchIndex < 0) {
                        break;
                    }
                    $whitespaceCandidate = $tokens[$searchIndex];
                    $whitespaceCandidateId = $whitespaceCandidate->getId();
                    if ($whitespaceCandidate->isArray() && T_WHITESPACE === $whitespaceCandidateId) {
                        $whitespaceIndex = $searchIndex;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (null !== $whitespaceTokenForIndent) {
                $normalizedWhitespace = str_replace(["\r\n", "\r"], "\n", $whitespaceTokenForIndent->getContent());
                $trailingWhitespace = strrchr($normalizedWhitespace, "\n");
                if (false === $trailingWhitespace) {
                    $trailingIndent = '';
                } else {
                    $trailingIndent = ltrim($trailingWhitespace, "\n");
                }
                if ('' === $indent) {
                    $indent = $trailingIndent;
                }
            }

            $lastLine = $stringContent;
            $newlinePosition = strrpos($stringContent, "\n");
            if (false !== $newlinePosition) {
                $lastLine = substr($stringContent, $newlinePosition + 1);
            }
            if ('' !== $indent && str_starts_with($lastLine, $indent)) {
                $lastLineWithoutIndent = substr($lastLine, \strlen($indent));
            } else {
                $lastLineWithoutIndent = $lastLine;
            }

            $contentLength = \strlen($stringContent);
            $endsWithUnescapedDollar = false;
            if (Preg::match('/\$/', $stringContent)) {
                if ($contentLength > 0) {
                    $lastCharacter = $stringContent[$contentLength - 1];
                    if ('$' === $lastCharacter) {
                        if ($contentLength >= 2) {
                            $characterBeforeLast = $stringContent[$contentLength - 2];
                            if ('\\' !== $characterBeforeLast) {
                                if (str_ends_with($lastLineWithoutIndent, '$')) {
                                    if (!str_ends_with($stringContent, '\\$')) {
                                        $endsWithUnescapedDollar = true;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            $endsWithUnescapedDollar = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if ($endsWithUnescapedDollar) {
                $tokenOfStringBeforeToken = new Token([T_ENCAPSED_AND_WHITESPACE, substr($stringContent, 0, -1).'\\$']);
            }

            $tokens[$index - 1] = $tokenOfStringBeforeToken;
            $tokens[$index] = new Token([T_CURLY_OPEN, '{']);
            $tokens[$index + 1] = new Token([T_VARIABLE, $variableContent]);
            $tokens[$dollarCloseIndex] = new Token([CT::T_CURLY_CLOSE, '}']);
        }
    }

part.text:
Implemented the fix in `src/Fixer/StringNotation/SimpleToComplexStringVariableFixer.php`.

The fixer now scans past array subscripts (e.g. `['key']`, `[0]`, `[$i]`) to locate the matching closing brace, instead of assuming the brace is always immediately after the variable name. This allows `${name['key']}` → `{$name['key']}` and `${name[0]}` → `{$name[0]}`.
